name: bi-measure-builder
description: Writes, explains, debugs, and optimizes BI calculations - Power BI / Fabric DAX measures and calculated columns, Tableau calculated fields (FIXED/INCLUDE/EXCLUDE LOD expressions, table calculations), and Looker LookML measures, dimensions, and derived tables. Use it whenever the request involves DAX, CALCULATE, a Power BI measure, a Tableau calc or LOD, LookML, or a business metric such as YoY, YT
